subject: delta(client): WF add the owner-bound bounded node JSON read and export listsWithin for the seller's enrollment reader
note: The node-wallet subpath gains fetchBoundedNodeJson(owner, body, {maxBytes, timeoutMs, signal}) in the new shipped file src/wallet/node-wallet-http.mjs: one JSON POST to the transport owner's own endpoint through the owner's fetch, delegated to the existing bounded fetch with the endpoint's origin fixed.
